note: Specs are authored against token names and resolved against the current Brand Guide at build time. `tokenRefs` records the original reference so a palette change updates every component here automatically.

components.name: Primary button
components.use: The main call to action. One per view.
rules: Never Flame fill. Flame on a button is 3.3:1 and fails AA.
The label is sentence case or title case, never all caps, never a command shouted.
The focus ring is 2px Ember, 3px offset, and Flame when the button sits on Midnight.

components.name: Ghost button
components.use: The secondary action beside a primary button, on Midnight or over footage.
rules: Only on dark grounds. On Parchment, the secondary action is a text link in Ember.
Never two ghost buttons in a row. One primary, one ghost, then stop.

components.name: Eyebrow / kicker
components.use: Opens a section or a record. Names what the reader is about to read.
rules: Every record opens with one. Law II.
All caps belongs here, to labels, and to the wordmark. Never to the serif.

components.name: Serif headline
components.use: Section and page headlines where the institution speaks.
rules: No bold cut exists. For more weight, go bigger.
Never all caps.
Below 36px, use DM Serif Text. Below 22px, use DM Sans.
components.html: No one told them it is already here.

components.name: Body copy
rules: Always DM Sans. The serif never carries extended reading.
Never Flame body text on a light ground.
Short sentences, one idea each.
components.html:
The local church is the plan. Not a strategy for it, the plan itself.

Every tribe. Every tongue. Every nation.
components.reactNote: a typographic rule, not a component

components.name: Card
components.use: A repeated unit in a grid: a guide, an initiative, a document.
rules: Cards sit on Parchment, never on Midnight, unless the whole band is dark and the card inverts.
Card text is Midnight. Watch for light-on-light inherited from a dark parent.

components.name: Record document
components.use: The canonical treatment for the prophecy, vision statements, official impact summaries, field reports, and initiative documents. Law II and Law IV in their purest form.
rules: Never decorated. No color blocks, no illustration, no icons.
Closes with a dateline and, where authority is claimed, real signatures.
A script font standing in for ink is a violation.

components.name: Full-bleed video hero

spec.video: muted, looping, playsinline, 6 to 15 seconds of real field footage

rules: Never text over footage without the scrim.
Never Flame or Ember text over footage.
The still fallback is honored under prefers-reduced-motion and on slow connections.
Nothing stock. Documentary footage from our own conferences, crusades, and streets.

components.name: Photo caption
components.use: Every published photograph. A photo without its record does not publish.

spec.structure: what happened, then event · place · date

rules: Names where known and permitted.
Bracketed fields mark anything not yet verified against the ministry record.
Written at capture, never from memory.

components.name: Testimony
components.use: The record of what God did. Four slots, always in order.

slots: Before: life as it was, in the person's own words
Encounter: the moment Jesus intervened, where and when
Transformation: what changed, specific, verifiable, honest
Outcome: life now, and the invitation to respond

rules: Real, consented, and named. Never fabricated, never composited, never anonymous.
Closes with an invitation to respond.

components.name: Form field
components.use: Every input on every surface: a partner form, a sign-up, a dashboard.

spec.label: DM Sans 600, 15px
spec.input: 17px DM Sans on rgba(11,26,45,.05), 1px rgba(11,26,45,.18) border, 4px radius, 44px minimum height
spec.placeholder: rgba(11,26,45,.60), never rgba(11,26,45,.38): a placeholder still has to be read
spec.error: #8C1D13 text and border. Never Flame, never Ember.
spec.hint: 13px rgba(11,26,45,.80), below the input, always present rather than appearing on failure

rules: The touch target is 44px whatever the visual height.
An error names what is wrong and how to fix it. 'Invalid' is not an error message.
Never signal an error with colour alone: the message text carries it.
Ember is reserved for the action. An error is not an action.

tokenRefs.input: 17px DM Sans on @wash, 1px @rule border, 4px radius, 44px minimum height
tokenRefs.placeholder: @ink-soft, never @ink-faint: a placeholder still has to be read
tokenRefs.error: @error-state text and border. Never Flame, never Ember.
tokenRefs.hint: 13px @ink-muted, below the input, always present rather than appearing on failure

components.name: Data table
components.use: Official figures, schedules, and any grid of records.

spec.header: DM Sans 600 uppercase 12px, letterspaced .14em, rgba(11,26,45,.80) on #F7F3EC
spec.scroll: the table scrolls inside its own container, never the page

rules: A wide table scrolls in its own frame. The page body never scrolls sideways.
Figures come from the official ministry record and carry a source line.

components.name: Email layout

spec.structure: nested tables, not divs. Outlook renders the table and ignores the div.
spec.css: inline styles on every element. No stylesheet, no custom properties, no var().
spec.fonts: Georgia for the serif and Arial for the sans. The webfont will not load and the fallback is the design.
spec.images: PNG only, with alt text that carries the meaning when images are blocked

rules: No SVG. Most clients strip it.
A dark-mode client may invert the ground: state colours explicitly on every cell and never rely on a default.
Every email carries a preheader, a reason the person is receiving it, and a working unsubscribe.
The logo is a PNG at 400px or 800px, never the vector.

components.name: Email button
components.use: The single call to action in an email.

spec.build: a table cell with a background, not a styled anchor: Outlook drops padding on an anchor

rules: One per email.
Never Flame fill: it fails contrast at 3.3:1 in an email exactly as it does on the web.
The link text says what happens, and the URL is visible in the footer for clients that strip links.
